chapter: War years, Decca records and La Conga
title: Why the Second Afro-Cubans was formed
summary: Mario wanted to give the talented Guerra a band for the off days, and Machito sang with him to help him get known.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Yes. Okay, then you - ahh - tell me how the second Afro-Cubans band was formed and why. I got Mario Bauza's version, let me hear your version.

Well, Marcelino is so talented and Mario love talent and he payed respect or tribute or he considers himself obligated to help a person that have talent. Marcelino had the language barrier. He don't want to Marcelino waste all his talent, so Mario says: "Let's organize a band for Marcelino", and he would play the two days that we had off here, the relief band and our own band; so he had two days and then we used to run matinees at the Diplomat, on Sundays, and through my telephone we'll book Marcelino Guerra and I used to go and sing few numbers with Marcelino Guerra because he was unknown for the Spanish people because he was new, so we showed that Marcelino Guerra-I - if I go and sing few numbers. I used to go to different places and sing few numbers and come back to La Conga, so after he was established he didn't need me anymore because he is a great singer.
How long did it take him to become established?
